text.scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_: Said to be someone's best friend, but maybe not. Shine on, you lazy diamond!
* Hey^1, boss^1! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!/%
A heart with a big heart. Always supporting others with her bullets.
* (Hathy is going to order a heart-foam latte.)/%
A simple organism that takes life one square at a time.
* (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)/%
A real dust bunny. Known to play dirty, but loves to play clean.
* (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/%
A shape changing fighter. Ironically, blocking is not its forte.
* Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!/%
It cries tears of joy that you are its boss.
An agent of CHAOS, he became DEVILSKNIFE to the pocket.
Obsessed with ranger shows, it lets everyone know it's better than Rudinn.
* Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh^1, you shouldn't have^1! (smile)/%
Although stronger than Hathy, seems to have fewer friends.
* (Head Hathy drinks an ice tea in silence...)/%
An aggressive antivirus. It's not down with the sickness.
* Pipooo^1! Nothing beats a nice shot of espresso..^1. Want me to give you a "shot"^1, too!?/%
Known to say ASOBOH, which means "Let's Play!" ... does it know that?
It was controlled by Queen. But, it's stronger and cooler now, so?
* (It has some kind of energy drink.)/%
It dreams of re-enacting scenes from cat and mouse cartoons.
A virus with a slightly criminal streak... and a heart of gold.
* Wanna share my soda? We'll both get sick that way..^1. Hee hee./%
Colorful and dandy, you can always count on him to work hard.
* Boss? Shall we sit down and enjoy a nice earl grey?/%
It absorbed the wire with fighting spirit. Gets flustered easily.
* (..^1. it's crushing its energy drink with its hand...)/%
Loves to coordinate outfits. Strongly dislikes clowns.
You recruited 3 big mice and you're stuck with it.
* (It's getting electricity from the melted cheese like a water wheel)/%
Passionate about music, but often taken advantage of by sinister types.
* (Seems to just be enjoying the musical ambience.)/%
Don't scream...! It's not the real monster, just the Darkner. Ooo la la.
* Shush^1! Don't do the move..^1. I am photographing the drink!/%
A bouncer that favors brute force over beauty. Gets lost easily.
* Say da word^1, boss..^1. I'll give dis drink a sip it won't forget./%
A real dust... frog. Known to play dirty, but loves to play... dirty.
* (Looks like it want to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)/%
The chatty office star. Obviously quite a looker despite her prudish wear.
* (Seems like they're drinking water.)&* (..^1. feels questionable.)/%
A sly customer that takes risk until luck strikes. ... cheating also works.
* This drink's not mine? It's fine. I'm just keeping it warm./%
The weather girl who really "makes it rain." Like... with water, though.
* Oh no^1, where's Lanino? He better not be having a team relationship.../%
A charming weatherman who can control the weather. Which, seems like cheating.
* Haven't been on a date alone for a while^1! ..^1. which^1, isn't a date./%

text.obj_hammer_of_justice_enemy_slash_Create: So you got moves,&so what?/%
You're facing a hero.&There isn't anything&that's gonna stand&in our way!/%
So the story goes,&so the story goes./%
But ain't every story&better with a little&twist?/%
H... huh?&Something&feels... off.../%
You won't&learn anything&runnin' away,&y'know!/%
If you've got&guts, let's see&how you deal&facing everything&head-on!!/%
(Kris, help&me out!)/%
If you've got guts,&c'mon and let your&axe do the talking!/%
You gotta BLOCK, you&understand?!/%
(Kris, don't mess&this up)/%
As long as you're GREEN,&you can't run away!/%
Unless you FACE DANGER&HEAD ON... These bullets&will do you in!/%
Did you ever hear&that old tale?/%
Yes, the old tale,&based upon the&prophecy.../%
Lord of the Hammer./%
Think I heard about it.&What happens?/%
Chapter 1&The March of&the Dark King./%
The heroes defeat&the king and&stop the dragon./%
Chapter 2&The City of &the Shining./%
The heroes do&battle in chariots&to save the Queen./%
Chapter 3, The &Isles of &Northernlight./%
The heroes travel&among the islands&and catch a glimpse&of a lost land./%
Chapter 4, The&Trials of the &Holy Hammer./%
A great smith gives&the heroes a&terrible weapon./%
Chapter 5, The &Field of Pink &and Gold./%
The vast garden is&charred in an inferno&of jealousy./%
...What happens next?/%
Geheheh! Who knows?/%
There was only one more&chapter... After that,/%
It all stopped./%
That next book, it&never did get written./%
The story, it became so &grand, so overwhelming,/%
Some say it swallowed up&the author himself./%
The ones who could write&the next, the youth,&the pen was lying&there for them to&pick up./%
To make the next page./%
...they never did./%
But you, my dear?&I see a story lit&up in your eyes.../%
Burnin' bright...&Burnin' black.&Burnin' up&everything./%
The bell's ringin' now.&Seems we've reached&the final rounds./%
So... how do you &think it all ends?/%
No, how do you want&it to end?/%
An ending, huh.../%
...If I could choose… &I guess.../%
I wouldn't have an &ending!/%
It's just better if&stuff just...&goes on forever, right?/%
Gah ha ha ha&ha ha ha!!! Well&ain't that somethin'./%
At this late hour,&with the bells ringing&out their justice./%
You choose eternity./%
Miss, hold on&dearly to that thought./%
For the tides of fate&are drawing close./%
And soon, an ocean&of ink shall wash&across the pages./%
But... there is one&thing that can&overwrite the dark./%
A white pen,&known as hope./%
Miss! I believe...&this is what you hold./%
Me? Nah, Kris&has the pen./%
My weapon's like a&hairbrush or something./%
Geh-hahahahaha!&Is that so?&Is that SO???/%
Yep.&Now shut up&and give me&that axe!/%
Wh... what kind&of cheap trick&was that!?/%
Sorry, thought you'd hit&it back! Geh heh heh!/%
Oh yeah!? I'll show&you!! Kris, let's use&it again!!/%
Hmm, dunno what&you just did,&but you should&probably keep&it up!/%
... y'know, since&you're gonna&lose if ya&don't, gahah!/%
Whew, gaha! What a rush!&You're really pickin'&this stuff up fast!&Now it's my turn...!/%
Before, you said you&fancied yourself a&hero, didn't ya?&Hmmm... That's&real interesting./%
Now, I don't know&much about "heroes"...&... But I know that&whatever ya call 'em,&there is someone./%
Someone who'll never&give up trying to&do the right thing,&no matter what./%
There's no prophecy&or legend 'bout anyone&like that./%
It's just something&I know is true./%
Now, where's my&haircut!? Geh ha ha!!/%
Now, where's my&haircut? Geh ha ha!/%
You aren't givin' up&now, are ya?/%
Put some shell into&it, will ya?/%
*\EA (Hey Kris, if this guy wants a haircut, let's ATTACK...!)
